launch_slurm_job: launch a SLURM training job with sbatch using specified nodes, GPUs, and model arguments
launch_cluster_distributed: launch a distributed training cluster across multiple nodes with NCCL and random port assignment
run_local_training: run training locally with specified GPUs using CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and tee logging
generate_requeue_handler: generate a bash trap handler script that requeues SLURM jobs on USR1 signal
get_random_port: get a random port number between 10000 and 20000 for distributed training communication
